user_prompt: Translate product release notes from English to Brazilian Portuguese while preserving brand names, version numbers, and inline code identifiers verbatim.
pre_baked_context: Source is markdown. Code spans (backticks) and code blocks must not be translated. Brand names: 'Snowdrift', 'Cascade', 'FlightDeck' — keep verbatim. Version strings like 'v2.3.1' verbatim. Target tone: professional but approachable, second person plural ('vocês') is fine. Preserve markdown structure exactly.
notes: Translation with strict preserve-list and structural fidelity; one-shot.
